bio: Nestled within the beautiful Derbyshire countryside, The Maynard is a luxury country home serving a delicious Afternoon Tea.  With a rich history and a warming sense of community, this stunning Peak District hotel combines contemporary sophistication and traditional hospitality.  The perfect venue to spend a relaxing afternoon with loved ones, The Maynard's talented chef's focus on quality, local produce and can adapt their freshly prepared food to cater for a range of dietary requirments. Guests can choose between their Classic Afternoon Tea of delicious sandwiches, warm crumbly scones and sumptuous sweets or their Gentleman's Afternoon Tea which includes an array of moreish savouries and is served with a pint of ale or lager.  Set within stunning, peaceful surroundings, The Maynard is located in Grindleford, within The Peak District National Park.
